9:["$","h2",null,{"children":"MLTSSL: Long-Term Skills"}]
a:["$","p",null,{"children":"The MLTSSL contains occupations Australia needs on a long-term basis. These are typically professional, technical, and trade occupations with sustained demand."}]
b:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Popular MLTSSL Occupations"}]

d:["$","p",null,{"children":"MLTSSL occupations are eligible for all skilled visas: 189, 190, and 491."}]
e:["$","h2",null,{"children":"STSOL: Short-Term Skills"}]
f:["$","p",null,{"children":"The STSOL contains occupations with current demand that may be more variable. These occupations are only eligible for the 190 and 491 visas, not the 189."}]
10:["$","h3",null,{"children":"STSOL Only Occupations"}]
11:["$","p",null,{"children":"Examples include certain marketing specialists, recruitment consultants, and other business professionals. These occupations require state nomination or regional sponsorship."}]
12:["$","h2",null,{"children":"ROL: Regional Skills"}]
13:["$","p",null,{"children":"The ROL contains occupations specifically needed in regional Australia. These are only eligible for the 491 visa."}]
14:["$","h3",null,{"children":"ROL Occupations"}]
15:["$","p",null,{"children":"Many trade occupations, agriculture-related roles, and some specialised professionals appear on the ROL. These occupations require you to live and work in a designated regional area."}]

17:["$","h2",null,{"children":"How to Find Your Occupation"}]
18:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Step 1: Identify Your ANZSCO Code"}]
19:["$","p",null,{"children":"ANZSCO is the Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations. Each occupation has a unique 6-digit code. Find the code that best matches your job duties and qualifications."}]
1a:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Step 2: Check the Lists"}]
1b:["$","p",null,{"children":"Use the Department of Home Affairs website to search for your ANZSCO code. The search will show:"}]
1c:["$","ul",null,{"children":[["$","li",null,{"children":"Which lists your occupation appears on"}],["$","li",null,{"children":"Which visas you can apply for"}],["$","li",null,{"children":"Your assessing authority"}],["$","li",null,{"children":"Any special conditions or caveats"}]]}]
1d:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Step 3: Verify with Assessing Authority"}]
1e:["$","p",null,{"children":"Your skills assessing authority can confirm whether your qualifications and experience match the occupation requirements. This is important because your skills assessment determines whether you can actually claim that occupation."}]
1f:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Occupation Ceilings"}]
20:["$","p",null,{"children":"Each occupation on the MLTSSL has an annual ceiling — a maximum number of invitations that can be issued per program year."}]
21:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Why Ceilings Matter"}]
22:["$","p",null,{"children":"Once an occupation's ceiling is reached, no more invitations are issued for that occupation until the next program year. This affects how competitive that occupation becomes."}]
23:["$","h3",null,{"children":"High-Demand Occupations"}]
24:["$","p",null,{"children":"Occupations like software engineers, nurses, and accountants often have higher ceilings but also more applicants. Regional and trade occupations may have lower ceilings but less competition."}]
25:["$","h2",null,{"children":"State-Specific Occupation Lists"}]
26:["$","p",null,{"children":"In addition to the federal lists, each state maintains its own occupation lists for nomination purposes."}]
27:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Why State Lists Differ"}]
28:["$","p",null,{"children":"States nominate based on their specific labour needs. A state might prioritise healthcare workers while another needs engineers or tradespeople."}]
29:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Checking State Lists"}]
2a:["$","p",null,{"children":"Visit each state migration website to see their current occupation priorities. Apply to states where your occupation is in demand."}]
2b:["$","p",null,{"children":["Read our"," ",["$","$L5",null,{"href":"/articles/state-nomination-australia","className":"text-blue-700 hover:underline","children":"state nomination guide"}]," ","for more details."]}]
2c:["$","h2",null,{"children":"When Lists Change"}]
2d:["$","p",null,{"children":"The occupation lists are reviewed and updated periodically, typically once or twice per year. Changes can include:"}]
2e:["$","ul",null,{"children":[["$","li",null,{"children":"Adding new occupations"}],["$","li",null,{"children":"Removing existing occupations"}],["$","li",null,{"children":"Moving occupations between lists"}],["$","li",null,{"children":"Adding or removing caveats"}]]}]
2f:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Protecting Your Application"}]
30:["$","p",null,{"children":"If your occupation is removed from the list after you submit your EOI or visa application, you are generally protected. However, it is always better to apply sooner rather than later."}]
31:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Tips for Occupation Selection"}]
32:["$","ul",null,{"children":[["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Choose carefully"}]," — your occupation affects which visas you can apply for"]}],["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Match your skills"}]," — your assessment must support your nominated occupation"]}],["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Check state demand"}]," — some occupations are in higher demand in specific states"]}],["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Monitor changes"}]," — lists can change, so stay informed"]}],["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Have a backup"}]," — consider if you qualify for multiple occupations"]}]]}]
